name: trackpad-mouse-tools
title: Trackpad & Mouse Tools
description: Change trackpad and mouse settings without opening System Settings. Switch secondary click between two fingers and a corner with one hotkey, set mouse and trackpad speed, toggle tap to click, natural scrolling and three finger drag, adjust gestures, and left, right or middle click or hold a mouse button from a hotkey.
author: jnbp

commands.name: toggle-right-click
commands.title: Toggle Secondary Click
commands.description: Switches secondary click between two fingers and the corner chosen in the preferences.

preferences.name: toggleCorner
preferences.title: Corner
preferences.description: Which corner the toggle switches to when leaving two finger click.

commands.name: right-click-two-finger
commands.title: Secondary Click with Two Fingers
commands.description: Sets secondary click to click or tap with two fingers.

commands.name: right-click-bottom-right
commands.title: Secondary Click in Bottom Right Corner
commands.description: Sets secondary click to the bottom right corner.

commands.name: right-click-bottom-left
commands.title: Secondary Click in Bottom Left Corner
commands.description: Sets secondary click to the bottom left corner.

commands.name: toggle-tap-to-click
commands.title: Toggle Tap to Click
commands.description: Turns tap to click on or off.

commands.name: toggle-natural-scrolling
commands.title: Toggle Natural Scrolling
commands.description: Turns natural scrolling on or off.

commands.name: toggle-three-finger-drag
commands.title: Toggle Three Finger Drag
commands.description: Turns three finger drag on or off. Three finger swipes move to four fingers while it is on, like in macOS.

commands.name: set-mouse-speed
commands.title: Set Mouse Speed
commands.description: Sets mouse tracking speed to a level from 1 (slowest) to 10 (fastest).

commands.name: set-trackpad-speed
commands.title: Set Trackpad Speed
commands.description: Sets trackpad tracking speed to a level from 1 (slowest) to 10 (fastest).

commands.name: increase-mouse-speed
commands.title: Increase Mouse Speed
commands.description: Moves mouse tracking speed one step faster.

commands.name: decrease-mouse-speed
commands.title: Decrease Mouse Speed
commands.description: Moves mouse tracking speed one step slower.

commands.name: left-click
commands.title: Left Click
commands.description: Left clicks at the pointer position. Give it a hotkey to click without pressing the trackpad.

commands.name: right-click
commands.title: Right Click
commands.description: Right clicks at the pointer position, independent of your secondary click setting.

commands.name: middle-click
commands.title: Middle Click
commands.description: Middle clicks at the pointer position. Give it a hotkey to open links in a new tab, close tabs or paste the selection without a middle mouse button.

commands.name: hold-left-click
commands.title: Hold Left Button
commands.description: Presses the left button and keeps it down until you run the command again, click, or a few seconds pass (set in the command preferences), for dragging with the trackpad.

preferences.name: release
preferences.title: Release
preferences.description: When the held button is let go. Running the command again always releases it right away.

data.title: When I Run the Command Again

preferences.name: seconds
preferences.title: Seconds
preferences.description: How long the button stays down when Release is set to After a Few Seconds.

commands.name: hold-right-click
commands.title: Hold Right Button
commands.description: Presses the right button and keeps it down until you run the command again, click, or a few seconds pass (set in the command preferences).

preferences.name: release
preferences.title: Release
preferences.description: When the held button is let go. Running the command again always releases it right away.

data.title: When I Run the Command Again

preferences.name: seconds
preferences.title: Seconds
preferences.description: How long the button stays down when Release is set to After a Few Seconds.

commands.name: hold-middle-click
commands.title: Hold Middle Button
commands.description: Presses the middle button and keeps it down until you run the command again, click, or a few seconds pass (set in the command preferences), e.g. to orbit in 3D apps.

preferences.name: release
preferences.title: Release
preferences.description: When the held button is let go. Running the command again always releases it right away.

data.title: When I Run the Command Again

preferences.name: seconds
preferences.title: Seconds
preferences.description: How long the button stays down when Release is set to After a Few Seconds.

commands.name: release-mouse-buttons
commands.title: Release Mouse Buttons
commands.description: Releases every mouse button held by this extension.

commands.name: settings
commands.title: Trackpad & Mouse Settings
commands.description: Browse and change every trackpad and mouse setting: secondary click, tap to click, look up, click pressure, tracking and scrolling speed, double-click speed, pointer acceleration, zoom and swipe gestures, and dragging style.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
